🚂 Sight Word Express

10 MIN · LISTEN · LOOK · SAY

Tap a carriage to hear its word

Don't be sad.
We are great!
Be happy.
Teacher script: “Look at the train! Listen. Don't. We. Be. Now, say the words together. Excellent! Point to ‘we’. Let's read: ‘We are great!’” Have students search their textbooks for these words.

Reference: supplied textbook image (classroom use).

📝 My Friend & Family

15 MIN · WRITING

Let's write an introduction!

This is my brother, Tom.

Try your own sentence:

Teacher cue: Model “This is my brother, Tom.” Invite students to introduce a friend or family member, then check capitals, spacing and full stops. Other examples are supplementary.

🔤 Phonics Review

15 MIN · TEACHER-EDITABLE

Build your verified phonics word list

The supplied Unit 15 manual names a phonics review but does not show the actual Unit 11–14 phonics targets. Enter words from those units below, separated by commas.

Teacher cue: Listen → repeat → blend → identify → read independently. Check the exact targets against Units 11–14.

🐰 Easter Egg Hunt

10 MIN · CULTURE & FESTIVALS
Let's find the Easter eggs! 🐣

Easter is a festival celebrated by Christians. Eggs and rabbits are familiar seasonal symbols in many Easter activities.

Teacher cue: Keep the cultural introduction short. The manual specifically advises against a full egg-painting or egg-rolling competition during this lesson. This digital hunt is an optional supplementary activity.

💛 Tales of Values

10 MIN · BE NICE
Be nice. Don't be rude! 💗
Teacher script: “Thumbs up! Cheer! Hurray! Now, is it kind to boo at our friends? No! Be nice. Don't be rude.” The manual teaches “Boo” for comprehension but reminds teachers not to encourage its use towards opponents.

Reference: supplied textbook image (classroom use).

👈 Left or Right?

KINDNESS CHALLENGE
Teacher cue: Ask “What should we do?” Let students discuss before answering. The situations are supplementary classroom practice inspired by the manual.

📋 Teacher's Guide

MANUAL-ALIGNED

⏱ Classroom timer

10:00

Teaching essentials

• Start with review of mistakes from earlier quizzes and homework.

• Teach sight words by listening, looking, saying, reading and finding words in the textbook.

• Use the model “This is my brother, Tom.” for guided writing.

• Review phonics using verified content from Units 11–14.

• Keep Easter activities within the allotted ten minutes.

• Teach the meaning of “Boo” without encouraging students to use it against classmates.
